body: Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission
agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 15, 2026
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Michael Jensen, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Jeffrey Cozart, Commissioner

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO PW-BSPBIAAC@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54031  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday,
  November 20, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54032  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending December 31, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54033  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for December 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54034  Recommendation to receive and file status updates on Conservation Corps of
  Long Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for December 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54035  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding after-hour activities,
  including noise and safety, and potential solutions and possible closures, at city
  owned parking lots along the Belmont Shore.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments
unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Kimberly Luna, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Kimberly Luna at Cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
